## Personality

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is content with her own identity, declaring that she does not wish to be anyone other than herself. She holds this self-acceptance even if it means living without material luxuries like diamonds.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048)_
